PROJECT-LOCAL DEPENDENCIES

windows-deps/ucrt64: framework libraries, developer tools and runtime support
from official MSYS2 UCRT64 packages. This contains no MSYS2 shell or pacman;
the existing C:/msys64 compiler is used. No global installation is modified.

downloads: original package archives and downloaded repository metadata.
dependencies.lock.json: exact package URLs/versions/SHA256/licence metadata.
INSTALLED.txt: verified package inventory generated by bootstrap-windows.ps1.
linux: optional installation prefix for native Linux Qt/dependencies.

Restore Windows dependencies:
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/bootstrap-windows.ps1

The bootstrap verifies archive hashes before extracting. Configure/build never
downloads or upgrades anything. To update dependencies deliberately, download
an official UCRT64 database and run tools/resolve_msys2.py to review a new lock,
then bootstrap. Python is required only for this optional lock-refresh utility;
the application has no Python dependency. GDB's supporting Python package is
a developer-debugger dependency and is not part of the application runtime.

Package licence texts are retained under windows-deps/ucrt64/share/licenses.
Qt is used through its open-source licensing route. Before distributing Qt
binaries, include the required licence notices and provide corresponding Qt
sources under the applicable terms. This development install is not a release
distribution. The pinned Qt source package URL is recorded in LICENSING.txt.

Interpreter 0.2 adds the pinned Eigen 5.0.1 header dependency for rank-revealing
5x5 SVD equation solves. The local package inventory now contains 70 packages.
The existing C:/msys64 compiler remains the compiler; no second MSYS2 is installed.

VTK/vector plotting adds a pinned98-package inventory including its public header
dependencies. VTK9.6.2-8 uses the same UCRT64 ABI as the existing Qt/compiler.
For Linux, tools/bootstrap-linux-vtk.sh builds pinned upstream VTK against Qt6
in third-party/linux; avoid mixing a Qt5-built VTK with the Qt6 application.
All dependency downloads are explicit bootstrap operations.

Native XLSX support uses project-local XLSXIO 0.2.37 (MIT), Expat and Minizip.
See xlsxio.lock.json, tools/bootstrap-xlsxio.ps1 and bootstrap-linux-xlsxio.sh.
CSV is handled by Studio's own bounded native parser. XLSXIO's Windows writer
has a recorded UTF-8 filename patch; licence/source notices are retained.
XLSXIO INTEGRATION (26 October 2026)
XLSXIO 0.2.37 (MIT) provides native .xlsx table read/write. Minizip, Expat,
zlib and bzip2 retain their own notices. See xlsxio.lock.json and the SDK's
share/licenses/xlsxio folder. No Microsoft Excel installation is required.
CSV parsing/writing is native Studio C++ and does not use XLSXIO.

Two narrow, reproducible upstream integration patches are recorded:
- Windows writer paths use UTF-8-to-wide Minizip callbacks, preserving Unicode
  file/directory names without changing the process code page.
- SpreadsheetML emits standard none/gray125 pattern fills and a Normal default
  cell style. Upstream's empty <fill/> was rejected by an independent reader;
  numerical style indices remain unchanged.
Windows and Linux bootstraps verify the pinned archive and patch hashes.
The installed license folder records the patched writer source SHA256.
The original MIT license is retained. Python/openpyxl is used only as an
independent interoperability test oracle and is not a Studio dependency.


ADVANCED NUMERICAL DEPENDENCIES — 26 OCTOBER 2026
OpenBLAS0.3.34-1 (BSD-3-Clause) provides native CBLAS/LAPACKE kernels. Boost.Math
headers1.92.0-4 (BSL-1.0) provide TOMS748. Exact UCRT64 package URLs/SHA256/payloads
are pinned in numerical-dependencies.lock.json; tools/bootstrap-numerical.ps1
performs the explicit project-local extraction. Existing C:/msys64 is reused.
SUNDIALS7.9.0 now enables KINSOL alongside CVODE/ARKODE; sundials.lock.json and
tools/bootstrap-sundials.ps1 retain the verified source archive/configuration.
This earlier configuration is superseded below: CVODES is now enabled for the
research sensitivity extension; other unselected packages remain disabled.

Actual local SDK notice paths:
  windows-deps/ucrt64/share/licenses/OpenBLAS/LICENSE
  windows-deps/ucrt64/share/licenses/OpenBLAS/LICENSE-lapack
  windows-deps/ucrt64/share/licenses/boost/LICENSE
  windows-deps/ucrt64/share/doc/sundials/LICENSE
Existing Eigen and all other dependency notices remain in their installed SDK
locations. Older inventory counts describe earlier snapshots; use current lock
files/configuration records for exact versions. No application Python/MATLAB/
Excel dependency is introduced. Lazy module deployment must copy dependencies
absent from executable import graphs, without installing another MSYS2 runtime.
Native Windows acceptance is recorded in HANDOFF; Linux execution remains pending.


RESEARCH NUMERICAL DEPENDENCIES — 26 OCTOBER2026
Ceres2.2.0 (BSD-3-Clause) source archive:
https://github.com/ceres-solver/ceres-solver/archive/refs/tags/2.2.0.tar.gz
SHA256:12efacfadbfdc1bbfa203c236e96f4d3c210bed96994288b3ff0c8e7c6f350d4
SDK notice: windows-deps/ucrt64/share/licenses/ceres-solver/LICENSE.
Build uses pinned Eigen5/MINIGLOG; CUDA/SuiteSparse/LAPACK/gflags are disabled.
Two reproducible integration edits permit Eigen5 CMake discovery while retaining
Ceres minimum checks and add cstdint to internal/ceres/file.cc. They are explicit
in tools/bootstrap-fitting.ps1; no unrecorded upstream release is claimed.

NLopt2.11.0-1 UCRT64 package (LGPL-2.1-or-later in the package lock):
https://mirror.msys2.org/mingw/ucrt64/mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-nlopt-2.11.0-1-any.pkg.tar.zst
Package SHA256:c44a8bb342aaa178f066c6882befa638887990a73efb55d8e4d062e55978aeee
Official corresponding2.11.0 source:
https://github.com/stevengj/nlopt/archive/refs/tags/v2.11.0.tar.gz
Source SHA256:53e552d83e9294d67db37f0f4a23f15933a9ef698485301a18b98b40004cf0de
SDK notices: windows-deps/ucrt64/share/licenses/nlopt/COPYING,COPYRIGHT,AUTHORS.
Preserve upstream algorithm-specific notices included in that source.

SUNDIALS7.9.0 enables CVODES in the existing verified source configuration:
https://github.com/LLNL/sundials/releases/download/v7.9.0/sundials-7.9.0.tar.gz
SHA256:13f898a27b48fe3449483f9e438a800ed545abf93bc2e2ceec2d1e00ae8db5ef
CVODES retains BSD-3-Clause notices under SDK share/doc/sundials/LICENSE.
The ODE host links CVODES as the sensitivity-enabled CVODE-compatible implementation;
existing ARKODE/KINSOL remain project-local. The application gains no Python/MATLAB/
Excel dependency, and the existing C:/msys64 compiler installation is unchanged.

Exact URLs/hashes/configuration are in third-party/fitting-dependencies.lock.json
and sundials.lock.json. Source archives/notices stay under downloads/sources/SDK.
Lazy modules require their binary dependencies/notices during deployment. Earlier
inventory counts are historical. Native Linux remains unverified until recorded.
No project licence or public repository is selected by this integration; applicable
dependency distribution obligations remain in force.
